reuse.why: Instead of extracting the local-reset part of the existing unlinkAccount into a shared helper, it re-lists the same eight-field db.updateAccount reset inline.

duplication.why: The detach block is a verbatim copy of unlinkAccount's field reset, so the definition of an 'unlinked account' now lives in two places.

placement.why: The detach side effect is put inside assertBankAccountNotLinked, a function whose name and role is a precondition check, and it runs before the link itself is created.

scope.why: Edits are limited to threading the flag through the six link handlers and the shared check, plus one unrelated-looking 'not found' throw.

maintainability.why: A future change to what unlink clears must be made twice, and a mutating 'assert' with a boolean flag is surprising to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: accounts/app.ts assertBankAccountNotLinked: resets account_id/bank/balances/sync fields directly with db.updateAccount instead of going through (a factored local part of) unlinkAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied db.updateAccount reset is a literal copy of unlinkAccount's, not reshaped.
